subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Must embedded turns preserve the exact `settings.retry.provider.maxRetries` budget by moving it to the outer lock-owning retry loop, or may embedded turns intentionally collapse configured retries to the current one-shot behavior?
rationale: The safe lock invariant requires zero SDK retries inside the released window, but deciding whether and how the existing configured retry count remains a public compatibility contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve configured retries outside the lock
options.body: Keep in-window SDK retries at zero and consume the configured retry count through whole-attempt retries that reacquire the session lock each time.

options.title: Adopt reduced embedded retry semantics
options.body: Explicitly approve the one-shot embedded behavior as a compatibility change and document the provider-setting exception and upgrade impact.

recommendation.title: Preserve configured retries outside the lock
recommendation.body: Keep in-window SDK retries at zero and consume the configured retry count through whole-attempt retries that reacquire the session lock each time.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the embedded session-lock lifecycle makes this person the strongest available owner for deciding where retry ownership belongs.
